passives.name: Instigate and Fabricate
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Increases Critical Hit Chance of enemies. This effect cannot be removed. Upon taking a critical hit, gains [Buff_V_licence_week_92] Unique Resource: Judgment of Steel and Oil, but loses [Buff_V_licence_week_94] upon taking a non-critical hit. When an enemy uses a non-attack skill, fully recovers Health of the caster. When hit by a non-Earth enemy, reduces Weakness Gauge damage by 50%, and does not take Weakness Gauge damage when taking a critical hit. Reduces damage taken from non-Earth enemies, and increases damage dealt to them. Increases damage taken from Earth enemies, and reduces damage dealt to them.
